sections.title: Critical Writing Seminar: Critical Composing
sections.description: Open only to upperclassmen who have not fulfilled their writing requirement. These seminars follow the same curriculum as the first-year seminars but are aimed at those who have taken two or more years of college courses and are open only to juniors and seniors. The text used in these upper division sections is a highly interdisciplinary book. It allows experienced upperclassmen to find a topic of personal interest and make it their own independent research project while they continue to hone the skills that they have started to develop in college.
